subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: What should the default contract be for completed run-mode subagent sessions: retain them as history, auto-archive them after archiveAfterMinutes, or hide them from active/status surfaces while retaining records?
rationale: Current code, tests, and docs disagree, and changing the default affects retained history, attachments, Control UI status, and users who rely on completed subagent transcripts.

options.title: Auto-archive completed run-mode subagents
options.body: Make archiveAfterMinutes apply to completed run-mode subagents by default, preserving transcript archives while removing stale session rows from active/list surfaces.

options.title: Retain but hide from active surfaces
options.body: Keep completed subagent records by default, but change sessions/status/Control UI projections so terminal children do not appear active or block the parent workflow.

options.title: Keep current retention and update docs
options.body: Document that default cleanup keeps run-mode subagent sessions and require users or agents to opt into cleanup="delete" for archival behavior.

recommendation.title: Auto-archive completed run-mode subagents
recommendation.body: Make archiveAfterMinutes apply to completed run-mode subagents by default, preserving transcript archives while removing stale session rows from active/list surfaces.
